summary: Preserve exact native retirement proof before PTY identity disappears

replay.detail: No projection replay or launch replay is introduced.

schema.detail: No additional database or runtime-record layout change.

rules.detail: No replicated claim or checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: For a finished start with verified operation provenance, a generation-fenced native PTY stop supplies retirement proof only after verified process-tree and work-scope retirement. One writer transaction binds the exact operation, resulting incarnation and terminate request/result receipts and resolves cleanup. Asynchronous stops supply no proof. Missing publication or provenance stays unresolved; an unreadable provenance lookup does not block ordinary incarnation-fenced stop authority.

downtime.detail: No interruption beyond the normal deployment restart already classified for the start-operation upgrade.

manual.detail: No additional operator action for positively verified native retirement. An older PTY producer that never publishes retains the separately documented operator escalation and producer-contract decision.

recovery.detail: The separately classified database and runtime-state restoration procedure applies; this change adds no separate migration.
